versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions to clarify where to get the API key ([pipispy.com](https://www.pipispy.com/)) and view the real-time dashboard ([pipiads.com](https://pipiads.com/)).
- Clarified the distinction between the official website and API portal.
- Improved verification notes to mention both pipiads.com and pipispy.com.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.

- Added a new "Trust & Execution Model" section explaining that the npm package is installed and executed locally as an MCP server.
- Clarified that npm install scripts may run, and described the local server's mediation of API access.
- Recommended reviewing the npm package and using a dedicated or isolated environment for stricter controls.
- No changes to features, tools, or integration—documentation enhancements only.

- Added new installation instructions highlighting that the skill installs the npm package pipiads-mcp-server@1.0.3 as a local MCP server.
- Provided guidance on using the skill in isolated or dedicated environments for stricter security.
- Included a verification section about dependencies and npm package review for supply-chain assurance.
- Added a data handling section with reminders not to send sensitive, private, or confidential information and to use caution with image inputs.
- No changes to available tools or core functionality.

- Expanded and clarified usage guidelines with new "When to Use", "When NOT to Use", "Best Practices", and "Core Workflow" sections.
- Improved and modernized the skill description and summary, emphasizing AI-powered research and analysis.
- Added a cost awareness section with guidance for avoiding unnecessary credit usage.
- Included a quick reference table mapping user intents to recommended tools.
- Restructured documentation for easier navigation and practical, real-world guidance.
- No changes were made to available tools or functionality.

- Changed server installation method to use npm instead of npx.
- Added an explicit install command for pipiads-mcp-server (version 1.0.3).
- Updated server startup to use pipiads-mcp-server directly.
- No changes to functionality or available tools.
